observability-aiops 0.2.0

- Documentation updated: SKILL.md refined and expanded for clarity.
- skill-card.md file removed.
- No core logic or functionality changes—this release focuses on documentation improvements and cleanup.

Initial release – governed operations for self-hosted Prometheus, Alertmanager, and Grafana deployments.

- Provides read/write tools for querying Prometheus (including PromQL), Alertmanager, and Grafana APIs.  
- Bundles a governance harness: audit log, policy engine, token/runaway budget guard, undo, and risk-tiering.
- Stores all credentials securely encrypted (never plaintext on disk); supports migration from legacy env-var tokens.
- Supports both read operations (metrics, targets, rules, alerts, dashboards) and guarded write actions (create/expire silence, update/delete dashboard, reload Prometheus config).
- Offers analyses: firing-alert root cause, target scrape health, and alert noise/flap identification.
- Requires no external skill-family; everything is in a standalone package.
- Preview-only: operations are mock-validated for initial release.
